output.methodChoice: Kepner-Tregoe Problem Analysis (IS/IS NOT on floors 6-8 vs 1-5 and date) and Decision Analysis; collected X1 only.
output.brief: The August drop is almost entirely a cooling problem on floors 6-8. Chiller CH-2, which serves those floors, failed on 4 August and was not restored until 19 August. Corridor temperatures there reached 27-30 C, and floor 6-8 scores fell to 6.8 during that window and recovered to 8.4 afterwards. Floors 1-5 barely moved and were not affected. Housekeeping, check-in, kiosks, and survey method all look unchanged or fine, so I would not serve notice on Orrin or pull the kiosks on this evidence. I am fairly confident about the chiller link. I am less sure how much the 6% rate rise added to the value dip, since the usual August seasonal pattern cannot be separated from it. Next steps: reschedule the deferred maintenance on both chillers, stock critical spare parts, and agree a written protocol for cooling outages. Do not exclude the August floor 6-8 scores. Consider a return-stay offer for affected guests, and review the rate decision separately.
